5147-5254-5902.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
5147-5254-5902.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without a stun counter on it

514-654-728-5944.description:
Activate The Mycosynth Gardens' third ability by paying {1} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Amulet of Vigor.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Unstoppable Slasher.
When Unstoppable Slasher dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two stun counters on it.
When Unstoppable Slasher enters, Amulet of Vigor and The Mycosynth Gardens trigger, untapping Unstoppable Slasher twice, which will instead remove both stun counters from Unstoppable Slasher.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1981-2415-2511-5332.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Carmen and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2034-3184-4766--190.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the non-Yomiji legendary creature, adding {C}{C}.
Yomiji and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Yomiji trigger, returning the legendary card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting that card onto the battlefield from your hand and attaching Deathrender to it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1251-3259-3699.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control a creature token.
1251-3259-3699.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Cadira, triggering Breath of Fury and Cadira.
Resolve the Cadira trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1778-3652-4973-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1778-3652-4973-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

876-1606-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two mana-producing lands.
876-1606-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Ley Weaver.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Ley Weaver.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Ley Weaver.
Activate two mana-producing lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping the lands.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Ley Weaver.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Ley Weaver.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Ley Weaver from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

1812-2440-7546.description:
Cast Maestro's Gift from exile by paying {U}{R}, creating a token copy of Inspired Skypainter with haste that enters prepared.
When the token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Lizard or Wizard creature you control.
If needed, activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {U/R}.
If needed, repeat step 3 an additional time.
Repeat.
1812-2440-7546.notes: Mana needed drops significantly for each additional creature you control that is a Lizard or Wizard.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

206-3259-6096.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-3259-6096.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and General Kreat as attackers.
General Kreat triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
206-3259-6096.notes: After the first loop, General Kreat doesn't have to attack, since the Goblin token attacking will trigger it.

1115-2440-7082-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka's first ability and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, attaching Trusty Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1558-3875-4231-4772-5233.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3875-4231-4772-5233.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Doubling Season.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

4331-4993-5116-7356.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0} due to Longshot.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

950-4742-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Fatestitcher.
Activate one of the Fatestitcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Fatestitcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

236-539-3899-3921-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Animating Faerie // Bring to Life
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

527-542-6968.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
527-542-6968.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1218-6714.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block the creature that has Super State attached.
1218-6714.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving the creature that has Super State attached +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Super State attached, causing the opponent it was attacking to get at least ten poison counters. The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.
Super State triggers, causing the creature to cause each opponent to get at least ten poison counters. The opponents lose the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

2043-4715-4772-4893.description:
Activate Urza by paying {4}, creating two token copies of Prized Statue that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
When the Prized Statue tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

3705-4050-5997-6556.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

1497-3327-4381-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1497-3327-4381-4613.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Activate Dargo using Wild Cantor's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

855-4120-4968.easyPrerequisites: Deathbringer Thoctar has a +1/+1 counter on it.
855-4120-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
855-4120-4968.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

440-1339-4050-6097.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-4050-6097.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

486-3401-5803.manaNeeded: {11}{U}{U} minus {1} for each other artifact you control
486-3401-5803.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
Artifacts you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
486-3401-5803.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's second ability by tapping it, causing Kitsa to become an artifact until end of turn.
Cast Blinkmoth Infusion by paying {12}{U}{U}, minus {1} for each artifact you control.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate any number of mana-producing artifacts you control, adding at least {2}.
Activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Blinkmoth Infusion.
Resolve the copy of Blinkmoth Infusion, untapping all artifacts you control.
Repeat from step 4.

2457-2557-4772-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1656-2335-4627.notablePrerequisites:
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
It is your precombat main phase.
1656-2335-4627.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Necrotic Ooze using Stern Marshal's ability by tapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

144-419-2713-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix, adding {U}.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
Activate Ixidor by paying {U}, turning Ashcloud Phoenix face up.
Repeat.

2397-3487-4374.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two energy counters.
2397-3487-4374.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, triggering Aetherstorm Roc twice, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

618-4050-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Kiki-Jiki.
You control a non-legendary creature.
618-4050-4222.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of any non-legendary creature you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

930-1486-1651.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Universal Automaton and another artifact, targeting Universal Automaton.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Universal Automaton.
Repeat.

654-774-1846-4300.description:
Cast High Tide.
Tap two Islands to add {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Meloku twice.
Activate Patron of the Moon, placing two Islands on the battlefield.
Untap the Islands with Amulet of Vigor's trigger.
Repeat.
